If you run into any obstacles, land too hard, or collide with the incredibly dumb AI competitors, your car will sustain serious damage. The majority of the levels are easy to finish the first time, but there are a few challenging ones scattered throughout that need trial and error. The game is boring, most of the tracks are straight forward, so you're holding accelerate for like 30mins until you're done with a few turns left and right. The graphics are straightforward; I assume the cars and the surrounding mountains are purchased models from an asset shop... The props and decorations on the track are fairly simple. Sometimes you have to make jumps, but instead of landing normally your car breaks. Why? I don't know the game decides to out of nowhere. Same jump next try is fine though.
